value.channel_description:
ZJ Liquid – The Ultimate DJ, Producer & Music Icon

ZJ Liquid is a renowned Jamaican DJ, producer, and radio personality with over 20 years in the industry. Hailing from Montego Bay, he became a household name at Zip FM, shaping dancehall, reggae, hip-hop, and R&B. His high-energy DJ sets and ability to break new music have made him a global ambassador for Jamaican music.

As the founder of H2O Records, Liquid has produced major riddims and collaborated with top artists, including gold-certified hits with Kranium. He has performed worldwide, from Japan to Dubai, the Caribbean, Europe, and North America, gracing stages like Rototom Sunsplash, Uprising Festival, and BET Awards Cypher.

Beyond DJing and production, Liquid is a mentor to rising talent, using his platform to elevate dancehall and reggae worldwide. His unmatched energy and passion keep him at the forefront of Caribbean music culture.

🔥 Subscribe for exclusive DJ mixes, throwbacks & new music from H2O Records!
